CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

2. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

4. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 8

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

6. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

7. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 64
   C. 8
   D. 9

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 46
   B. 23
   C. 120
   D. 30

9. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

10. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

11. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23
   C. 29
   D. 23.7

12. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

13. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 37
   D. 1

14. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 1

15. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

16. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 2
   D. 1

17. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

18. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 1, 2, 3, 6

19. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 88
   C. 38
   D. 19

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 33
   C. 28
   D. 14

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 30
   C. 45
   D. 36

23. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

24. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 31
   C. 25
   D. 17

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
